mapper.select: SELECT R.*, P.PNAME AS pName FROM P_CHAT_ROOM R JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = R.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT R.*, P.PNAME AS pName, SI.PROFILE_IMG AS sellerProfileImg FROM P_CHAT_ROOM R JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = R.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO SI ON SI.USER_ID = R.SELLER_ID WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
